about: The castle's entrance hall at night, chapter 2's first story: the painting (image-first-entrance) with its grid removed by Gemini. A story's scene with no level: nothing in it opens or is picked up. The far wall's face round its three arches is cut as a static thing (D89), so that whoever walks into an arch goes under it; the rest is ground; the doors of its two side arches are taken out (door_left, door_right). Pictures named here are in art/raw/, which git ignores.

repaint.about: The chain the lamp hangs from, taken out so that it hangs from its wooden ring as if fixed to a ceiling out of the picture: filled from its sides by tools/art/repaint.py (fill), the painting kept pixel for pixel elsewhere.

door_left.about: The left arch's door, one leaf open toward us before a round doorway (the owner, 2026-10-28: an open door swings in, out of sight): taken out, the arch's stones and the wall's face going on there. Painted by Gemini 3 Pro Image from tools/art/prompts/game-entrance-door-left.md on the canvas this makes, and joined by tools/art/repaint.py, the painting kept pixel for pixel outside the box; the marked picture mended with it.

door_right.about: The right arch's door, as the left one's, mended after it.

fill.about: The foot of each door taken out of the far wall's side arches (door_left, door_right), left on the floor below each arch, at 11,10 and 28,10, by the edits that took the doors out: filled from all four sides by tools/art/repaint.py (fill), the floor going on across it, the painting kept pixel for pixel elsewhere; the marked picture filled with it.

far_wall.about: The far wall's face, its arches' stones, its pillars and its knights, drawn over whoever walks into the arches: the wall's box less what is seen through its three openings, which Gemini painted magenta. Its top is the wall's own top edge, the coping's outline, so that a figure gone into a tunnel behind the wall (D319) shows nothing over the coping.

source:
# The entrance hall

Kydux's own art, made for the game and under the GNU GPL, version 3 or
later, like the rest of it.

- Painted by Gemini 3 Pro Image (`gemini-3-pro-image`) from
  `tools/art/prompts/image-first-entrance.md`, with the field as its style's
  reference, then edited by it without its grid (`game-entrance-nogrid.md`).
- The chain its chandelier hung from taken out, filled from its sides by
  `tools/art/repaint.py` (fill), so that the chandelier hangs from its ring.
- The doors of its two side arches taken out, each swung in out of sight
  and its doorway open, painted by Gemini from `game-entrance-door-left.md`
  and `-right.md` in a box of the painting each, joined by
  `tools/art/repaint.py`.
- Its benches, torches, knights and chandelier, and the openings of its far
  wall's arches, painted flat magenta by Gemini in crops of the painting
  (`game-entrance-marked-*.md`, the chandelier asked eight times and voted),
  and cut there with their outlines (static things); its front wall and the
  gate's posts cut by polygons, each edge on its outline.
- Its cells marked by hand and exported by `tools/art/export_scene.py`.

marks.about: Gemini's pictures of parts of the hall with its things painted flat magenta (the owner's way, 2026-10-27), laid on the painting by tools/art/repaint.py marks: which thing each of the benches', torches', knights' and the lamp's masks is, its edge the painting's outline; and the three openings the far wall is cut round.

unseen.about: The view ends at the far wall's top edge (D323): the starry band painted above the coping, where the hall's wall goes on up out of the picture, is never shown. 2.07 cells, the coping's outline at 198 to 200 pixels of the ground along the whole wall.

dark.about: The left arch's dark corridor: a figure going in from row 8 darkens on row 7 and is all but lost on row 6.
The middle arch's deeper corridor: a figure darkens from row 7 and is all but lost on row 5.
The right arch's dark corridor, as the left one's.
